how_to_apply: Visit the official PFRDA website, www.pfrda.org.in, and open the "Careers" section.
Open the recruitment notification titled "PFRDA Recruitment Exercise – Recruitment of Officer Grade A (Assistant Manager) - 2026" and click "Apply Online".
Choose "Click Here for New Registration" and enter your name, contact details and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
Fill in the application form; use "Save and Next" to save progress if the form cannot be completed in one go.
Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and the handwritten declaration as per the specified guidelines.
Fill in remaining application details and use the Preview tab to verify all entries before clicking "Complete Registration" (no changes are allowed after this step).
Click the "Payment" tab and pay the applicable fee online.
Click "Submit" and save/print the system-generated application form and e-receipt for future reference.
The online application window is open from 03.09.2026 to 24.09.2026. No other mode of application is accepted, and candidates need not send a printout to PFRDA's office.
important_instructions: Candidates can apply for a maximum of 2 streams only, subject to eligibility; a separate application and fee is required for each stream. No request for change/correction in application particulars (including category) will be entertained once the application is submitted. Selected candidates are liable to be posted to any PFRDA department in New Delhi or Mumbai, and to serve anywhere in India as required. Successful candidates will undergo a probation period of two years. Candidates already employed in Govt./Quasi-Govt. organisations or PSU banks must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. Outstation candidates called for interview will be reimbursed single AC Three Tier return railway fare by the shortest route, subject to documentary evidence. A candidate is allowed to appear only once in the online examination for a post; multiple appearances will lead to cancellation of candidature. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. Any addendum/corrigendum/notice will be published only on www.pfrda.org.in.

content_sections.heading: PFRDA Officer Grade A Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 30 vacancies have been notified for PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026, spread across four streams. Category-wise reservation is included in parentheses for each stream. Overall category-wise total: SC-5, ST-2, OBC-8, EWS-3, UR/GEN-12, Total-30, of which 2 posts are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Candidates in the OBC 'Creamy Layer' are not entitled to OBC reservation and must indicate their category as UR/GEN.

rows.no_of_posts: 25 (SC-4, ST-2, OBC-7, EWS-3, UR/GEN-9; includes 1 PwBD – Blindness & Low Vision, 1 PwBD – Deaf & Hard of Hearing)

content_sections.heading: PFRDA Officer Grade A Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: PFRDA Officer Grade A eligibility 2026 covers nationality, educational qualification and age limit. Applicants must be Indian citizens, computer literate, and conversant with MS-Office (Word and Excel). Candidates can apply for a maximum of 2 streams, with a separate online application and fee required for each stream. Eligibility for the General stream also extends to candidates holding a Bachelor's degree in Law, Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or ACA/FCA (ICAI), ACS/FCS (ICSI), ACMA/FCMA (ICMAI), or CFA (CFA Institute).

content_sections.heading: PFRDA Officer Grade A Qualification (As on 31.07.2026)
content_sections.text: The notification clarifies that all above degrees/diplomas must be recognized as equivalent to a Master's Degree by the Association of Indian Universities. Candidates awaiting final qualifying results may also apply, subject to producing proof of the qualification within the time allowed if selected.

rows.educational_qualification: Master's Degree/PG Diploma (min. 2 years) in any discipline; OR Bachelor's Degree in Law; OR Bachelor's Degree in Engineering; OR ACA/FCA (ICAI); OR ACS/FCS (ICSI); OR ACMA/FCMA (ICMAI, erstwhile AICWA/FICWA from ICWAI); OR CFA (CFA Institute)

Master's Degree/PG Diploma (min. 2 years) in Economics/Commerce/Business Administration/Econometrics/Quantitative Economics/Financial Economics/Mathematical Economics/Business Economics/Agricultural Economics/Industrial Economics/Business Analytics; OR in Finance/Quantitative Finance/Mathematical Finance/Quantitative Techniques/International Finance/Business Finance/International & Trade Finance/Project & Infrastructure Finance/Agri. Business Finance; OR in Statistics/Mathematical Statistics/Statistics & Informatics/Applied Statistics & Informatics/Data Science/AI/Machine Learning/Big Data Analytics; OR Master's Degree in Mathematics with one-year PG Diploma in Statistics or related subjects
Graduation from a recognized University/Institute AND Pass or exemption in all seven (07) 'Core Principles' subjects of the Institute of Actuaries of India (IAI) Examination

Master's Degree in Hindi/Hindi Translation with English as a subject at Bachelor's level; OR Master's Degree in Sanskrit/English/Economics/Commerce with Hindi as a subject at Bachelor's level; OR Master's Degree in both English and Hindi/Hindi Translation

content_sections.heading: PFRDA Officer Grade A Age Limit (As on 31.07.2026)
content_sections.text: A candidate must not have exceeded 30 years of age as on 31 July 2026, i.e., must be born on or after 1 August 1996. Candidates covered under more than one relaxation category (e.g., SC/ST/OBC who are also PwBD or Ex-servicemen) are eligible for cumulative age relaxation, as per the notification. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

rows.age_relaxation: 10 years (applicable whether the post is reserved or not)

Other benefits include Leave Fare Concession, medical expense reimbursement, Personal Accident Insurance, Children Education Allowance, Knowledge Updation Allowance, conveyance expenses, House Cleaning Allowance, and a Pluxee Meal Card, among others admissible to an Officer Grade A in PFRDA.

content_sections.heading: PFRDA Officer Grade A Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026 is a three-stage process: Phase I – Online Screening Examination: Two papers of 100 marks each (Paper 1: English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, Test of Reasoning, General Awareness - common to all streams, 90 questions, 60 minutes; Paper 2: stream-specific subject, 50 questions, 40 minutes). Negative marking of 1/4th mark applies. Marks are used only for shortlisting to Phase II and are not counted in final selection. Phase II – Online Examination: Paper 1 is a descriptive English test (3 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes, 1/3rd weightage); Paper 2 is a stream-specific objective paper (50 questions, 100 marks, 40 minutes, 2/3rd weightage). Negative marking of 1/4th mark applies to Paper 2. Candidates equal to 5 times the number of vacancies are shortlisted, in merit order, for Phase III. Phase III – Interview: Conducted only for candidates shortlisted after Phase II; can be attended in Hindi or English. Final selection is based on marks obtained in Phase II (85% weightage) and Phase III (15% weightage). Marks obtained in Phase I are not counted towards final selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is PFRDA's recruitment drive (Advt. No. 03/2026) to fill 30 Officer Grade 'A' (Assistant Manager) posts across the General, Research, Actuary, and Official Language (Rajbhasha) streams.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 30 vacancies: 25 in General, 2 in Research, 2 in Actuary, and 1 in Official Language (Rajbhasha).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by stream- a relevant Master's Degree/PG Diploma (or equivalent professional qualification such as Law/Engineering degree, ACA/FCA, ACS/FCS, ACMA/FCMA, or CFA for the General stream); actuarial exemptions for the Actuary stream; and Hindi-related postgraduate qualifications for the Official Language stream. Full details are in the qualification table above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must not have exceeded 30 years of age as on 31 July 2026 (born on or after 1 August 1996), with age relaxation available for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, and Ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 1,000/- (inclusive of GST) for UR/GEN, EWS and OBC candidates; no fee for SC/ST/PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online at www.pfrda.org.in through the "Careers" section between 3 September 2026 and 24 September 2026; no other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves Phase I (online screening exam, used only for shortlisting), Phase II (online exam, 85% weightage in final result), and Phase III (interview, 15% weightage in final result).

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for PFRDA Officer Grade A (Assistant Manager)?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 62,500-3600(4)-76,900-4050(7)-1,05,250-EB-4050(4)-1,21,450-4650(1)-1,26,100 (17 years), with gross emoluments of approximately Rs. 2,05,000 per month at the minimum of scale, inclusive of allowances.

faq.question: Q10. Where will selected PFRDA Officer Grade A candidates be posted?
faq.answer: PFRDA currently has offices in New Delhi and Mumbai; selected candidates may be posted at either office and are also liable to serve anywhere in India as required by the Authority.
